newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Echlin Inc Q3 shr profit narrows.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Echlin Inc Q3 shr profit narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Results from Sept. 1, 1996 forward include Iroquois Tool Systems Inc, which Echlin acquired as a pooling of interests in fiscal 1997.
The company said most of the 10 percent net sales gain from a year ago is due to recent acquisitions.

Unit sales of comparable operations fell 1 percent from a year ago due to softness in the North American aftermarket for engine system products and a decline in the European original equipment market for heavy-truck brake parts.
Earnings also were hurt by unabsorbed fixed costs resulting from efforts to balance production with lower unit sales.
Year-to-date results include a one-time gain of $0.07 per share from the sale of its Sensor Engineering division in Q1.
